verdict.rationale: Jina Reader offers x-respond-timing to trade off latency vs completeness and x-max-tokens to cap output, which resemble adaptive stopping controls, but these are manually-set parameters rather than an autonomous mechanism that detects 'enough information gathered to answer the query' and stops on its own. There's no evidence of query-aware adaptive crawling logic, only per-request format/engine/timing knobs. missing for 10: autonomous query-relevance stopping criteria, evidence of dynamic multi-page crawl termination based on answer sufficiency, independent validation of x-respond-timing behavior.
